description: `<Profiler id onRender>` calls `onRender(id, phase, actualDuration, baseDuration, startTime, commitTime)` each time its subtree commits.
`actualDuration` is the time spent in this commit; `baseDuration` estimates a full re-render without memoization. A large gap means memoization is working.
Records commits as flame graphs and ranked charts, and can explain why each component rendered.
DevTools setting that flashes components when they re-render, revealing wasted renders.
React 19.2+ Scheduler and Components tracks inside the Chrome DevTools Performance panel.
